size.description: int or tuple of ints, optional Output shape. If the given shape is, e.g., ``(m, n, k)``, then ``m * n * k`` samples are drawn. Default is None, in which case a single value is returned.
constraints: size affects the output shape and number of samples drawn
if size is not provided, a single value is returned

output.description: ------- ndarray or scalar The drawn samples.
